posture.general_guide: These are starting points. Rename anything, change the units, delete what you do not need.
posture.record_only: Health Trail records what you write down and what clinicians tell you. It does not interpret values, flag anything as normal or abnormal, or advise.
posture.no_ranges: Never display target ranges, normal ranges, color coded values, or warnings on any measurement.

progress_presets.name: Weight
progress_presets.cadence: Weekly, or whenever a clinician asks
progress_presets.notes: Medication start markers are useful here, for example when a new medication is started and the family wants the timing visible on the chart.

progress_presets.name: Blood pressure
progress_presets.notes: Record who took the reading, since readings taken at home and at a clinic often differ.

progress_presets.name: Moving around
progress_presets.notes: Plain language on purpose. Record what the therapist said, not your own rating.

progress_presets.name: Wound or pressure sore
progress_presets.cadence: Per dressing change or clinician visit
progress_presets.notes: Photographs and dates only. The stage field records what a clinician told you, and the label must say so.

progress_presets.name: Pain
progress_presets.notes: This is their own report of their pain, not your assessment of it.

progress_presets.name: Mood and behavior
progress_presets.notes: Observation only. The field is what you saw or what staff told you, never a conclusion about why.

progress_presets.name: Fluids
progress_presets.cadence: Only when a clinician asks the family to track it

progress_presets.name: Dialysis sessions
progress_presets.notes: Attendance and their own report of how they felt. Nothing clinical.

progress_presets.name: Treatment cycles
progress_presets.notes: Side effects are recorded as observations of what happened, not as something to act on.

progress_presets.name: Falls
progress_presets.notes: This connects to standing instructions about being notified after a fall. Record who told you and when.

progress_presets.name: Growth
progress_presets.notes: Record the numbers the clinic measured. Never show percentiles or comparisons.

progress_presets.name: Bathroom
progress_presets.cadence: Daily, if it matters right now
progress_presets.notes: Kept deliberately plain and private. Some families track this during a specific problem and then stop.

federal.label: Backed by federal rules for nursing homes
federal.explainer: Federal rules for nursing homes that take Medicare or Medicaid require this. Other kinds of places, like assisted living and home care agencies, are not covered by those same rules.

request.label: Your request
request.explainer: This is a reasonable thing to ask for, but no rule requires them to agree. Ask for it in writing anyway.

standing_instructions.name: Call me about any fall or injury
standing_instructions.wording: Please call me right away if there is a fall or any injury, and tell me what happened and what was done.
standing_instructions.basis: Federal nursing home rules require the facility to notify the resident's representative about an accident with an injury that may need a doctor's attention, and about significant changes in condition.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Ask for it to be written into the care plan, and ask who makes the call at night.

standing_instructions.name: Tell me about medication changes
standing_instructions.wording: Please tell me when any medication is started, stopped, or changed.
standing_instructions.basis: Federal nursing home rules require notice when there is a need to change treatment significantly. Small routine changes may not be covered, so ask for those too.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Ask for it in the care plan, and ask who will call.

standing_instructions.name: Tell me before treatment changes
standing_instructions.wording: Please tell me before starting or stopping any treatment or therapy.
standing_instructions.basis: Federal nursing home rules require notice of a significant change in treatment.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Ask for it in the care plan.

standing_instructions.name: Include me in care plan meetings
standing_instructions.wording: Please include me in every care plan meeting and tell me the schedule ahead of time.
standing_instructions.basis: Federal nursing home rules give residents and their representatives the right to take part in care planning.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Ask for the meeting schedule in writing and ask to be added to the notification list.

standing_instructions.name: Call me immediately about any hospital transfer
standing_instructions.wording: If they are sent to the hospital, please call me right away and tell me where and why.
standing_instructions.basis: Federal nursing home rules require notice of a decision to transfer or discharge.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Ask what the after hours call process is, and get the name of who makes that call.

standing_instructions.name: Follow the signed orders and call me first
standing_instructions.wording: Our wishes are in the signed orders dated [date], kept at [location]. Please follow them and call me before anything changes.
standing_instructions.basis: Federal rules require facilities to honor advance directives and to tell you their policies about them.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Confirm the signed orders are in the chart and flagged where staff will see them fast.

standing_instructions.name: Who you can share information with
standing_instructions.wording: Please share information with these people: [list]. Please follow these visitor preferences: [list].
standing_instructions.basis: Federal nursing home rules protect visitation and give control over who receives information. Specific preferences beyond that are requests.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Confirm the authorized contact list is on file and ask to see it.

standing_instructions.name: Tell me before a room or roommate change
standing_instructions.wording: Please tell me before any room change or roommate change.
standing_instructions.basis: There are notice rules around moves within a facility, but being told in advance about a roommate change is mostly something you have to ask for.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Ask for it to be added to the care plan so it survives staff turnover.

standing_instructions.name: Get my okay before outside services that cost money
standing_instructions.wording: Please get my okay before sending them to any outside dentist, podiatrist, lab, or other service that may be billed to us.
standing_instructions.basis: No rule requires a facility to get your approval first, though there are separate rules about cost estimates and out of network notices in some situations.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Ask for it in writing in the file, and ask for a cost estimate before anything is scheduled.

standing_instructions.name: Do not discuss discharge without me
standing_instructions.wording: Please do not discuss discharge or moving without me present or informed first.
standing_instructions.basis: You do have a right to be notified of a decision to transfer or discharge, and a right to appeal it. Being present for every conversation is something you have to ask for.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Ask for the notice process in writing, and ask who is responsible for calling you.

standing_instructions.name: Keep these food restrictions on file
standing_instructions.wording: Please keep these food restrictions and preferences on file: [list]. Tell me if they cannot be followed.
standing_instructions.basis: Care plans are supposed to reflect needs and preferences, so this is well supported, but the specific list is something you provide and confirm.
standing_instructions.ask_for: Confirm it is in both the care plan and the kitchen's system, and check back after a month.
